Additionally, the opponent's Ral has 8 loyalty counters and is a major threat. Burst Lightning should target either the opponent (bringing them to 2 life, within range of future burn) or Ral to remove loyalty counters. Targeting yourself is throwing away 2 life points for absolutely no benefit when you're already at a low life total.
annotations.actionTaken: Targeted themselves with Burst Lightning, dealing 2 damage to themselves (6 -> 4 life)
annotations.betterLine: Target Haiku Worrier (opponent at 4 life) with Burst Lightning to deal 2 damage, bringing them to 2 life and putting them in range of any future damage source. With Opt and Sleight of Hand in hand to dig for more burn, plus another Eddymurk Crab for board presence, targeting the opponent was clearly correct.

annotations.description: GPT52 Vet targeted themselves with Burst Lightning, dealing 2 damage to themselves (going from 6 to 4 life) instead of targeting the opponent at 4 life for lethal damage. The opponent is at 4 life, and Burst Lightning deals 2 damage. While 2 damage alone doesn't kill the opponent, targeting the opponent puts them to 2 life and is vastly better than dealing damage to yourself. Moreover, looking at the stack, Burst Lightning is already on the stack targeting - this is a critical error. The opponent is at 4 life and GPT52 Vet has Burst Lightning (2 damage). Even if not lethal alone, dealing 2 to an opponent at 4 is infinitely better than dealing 2 to yourself at 6 life. Additionally, targeting Ral at 8 loyalty could also be considered since Ral is a major threat approaching ultimate.
